name: production-deploy-gate
body: allow if actor.role == 'deployer' and time.hour >= 9 and time.hour < 17
description: Restrict production deploys to business hours (09:00–17:00 UTC)

name: financial-approval-threshold
description: Require finance approver role for transactions >= $10,000

name: database-schema-change
body: allow if actor.role in ['dba', 'senior_engineer'] and context.reviewed == true
description: Database schema changes require DBA or senior engineer with peer review

name: secret-rotation
body: allow if actor.role in ['security_engineer', 'sre'] or actor.id == context.requester_id
description: Secret rotation allowed by security team or the original secret owner
